name: Media gRPC Transport Security Criteria
description: Requires every standalone Media gRPC launcher to use the shared fail-closed TLS policy in production-like profiles while permitting plaintext only in explicit local/test contexts.

criteria.description: STT, TTS, Vision, and Multimodal launchers must resolve transport security through the shared Media policy and bind the resolved security explicitly.
The common Media transport policy must prove production-like TLS requirements, shared TLS fallback, service-specific precedence, pair integrity, and local plaintext behavior.
Canonical orchestration, storage, scoring, freshness, and release interpretation remain owned by the ghatana-lifecycle Evidence Generator.

acceptanceCriteria.pass: All four standalone Media gRPC services share one TLS policy, production/staging/sovereign cannot bind plaintext, TLS material is validated before binding, and Lifecycle records canonical evidence.
acceptanceCriteria.fail: Any standalone Media gRPC service bypasses the shared policy, a production-like profile can bind plaintext, TLS pairs can be partially/mixed configured, unsafe TLS paths are accepted, focused tests fail, or canonical ownership is violated.
acceptanceCriteria.reviewGate: The ghatana-lifecycle Evidence Generator executes and scores this producer; GitHub Actions is provenance only.
